With no args or a file path: read Mermaid or TGF and print the conversion. Use the 'serve' subcommand to run the embedded web UI.

Usage:

Available Commands:

  help        Help about any command
  serve       Serve the embedded web UI

Flags:

Use "mermaid2tgf [command] --help" for more information about a command.
